import pathlib,json,collections,hashlib
D=pathlib.Path.cwd();Q=D.parent/'review-packet'
read=lambda n:json.loads((Q/n).read_text())

raw=[e for e in cat['entries'] if e['id'] in ids]; rawid={e['id']:e for e in raw}

  total+=1;r=json.loads(line)

pid={e['id']:e for e in proc};cid={e['id']:e for e in clauses}

sids=[e['leafId'] for e in sem];pids=[e['leaf']['id'] for e in pending]
check('partition140plus287',len(sids)==len(set(sids))==140 and len(pids)==len(set(pids))==287 and not(set(sids)&set(pids)) and set(sids)|set(pids)==ids)
check('selected149 equals140plus9',set(sids)<=set(sid) and len(set(sid)-set(sids))==9)

check('all pending leaf exact',all(e['leaf']==oid[e['leaf']['id']] for e in pending))
check('all proposal catalogContract exact raw',all(e['catalogContract']==rawid[e['leafId']] for e in sem))
check('original counts',collections.Counter(e['extraction_status'] for e in orig)=={'STATIC':250,'UNKNOWN':177})

check('all proposed not accepted/notrun',all(e['association']=='SEMANTIC_PROPOSAL_NOT_ACCEPTED' and e['procedureStatus']=='PROPOSED_NOT_RUN' and e['acceptance']=='NOT_GRANTED' and e['runtimeEvidence']==[] for e in sem))
check('12procedures notrun',len(pid)==12 and all(e['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_RUN' and e['execution']=='NOT_RUN' for e in proc))
check('25clauses notrun',len(cid)==25 and all(e['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_RUN' and e['runtimeEvidence']==[] for e in clauses))
check('duplicated clause exact',all(c==cid.get(c['id']) for e in proc for c in e.get('observationClauses',[])) and len([c for e in proc for c in e.get('observationClauses',[])])==25)
check('108 facet snapshot identity exact',all(all(e['individualFacet'][k]==e['catalogContract'][k] for k in ['symbol','kind','shape']) for e in sem[32:]))
check('108 clause references exist and primary matches',all(e['observationClauses'] and all(c in cid and cid[c]['procedure']==e['primaryProcedure'] for c in e['observationClauses']) for e in sem[32:]))
check('all primary procedures exist',all(e['primaryProcedure'] in pid for e in sem))
anchors=[]
for e in sem:
 a=e['sourceAnchor'];anchors.append((a['source'],a['range']))
 for a in e.get('supportingSourceAnchors',[]): anchors.append((a['source'],a['lines']))
for e in proc+clauses:
 for a in e.get('anchors',[]):anchors.append((a['source'],a['lines']))
check('all anchor files present ranges valid',all((Q/'reference'/s).is_file() and 1<=r[0]<=r[1]<=len((Q/'reference'/s).read_text().splitlines()) for s,r in anchors),len(anchors))
canon=lambda v:hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
base=read('retained-base.json')
check('retained first4 canonical digest',canon(proc[:4])==base['oldProceduresCanonicalSHA256'],canon(proc[:4]))
check('retained first32 canonical digest',canon(sem[:32])==base['oldBindingsCanonicalSHA256'],canon(sem[:32]))
w=read('closed-event-witnesses.json');wresults=[]
for leaf,v in w.items():
 e=rawid[leaf];decl=e['shape']['declarations'][0];name=v['name'];text=(Q/'reference'/v['source']).read_text().splitlines()
 wresults.append(dict(id=leaf,name=name,ok=(len(name.encode())==v['utf8Bytes']==decl['declared_name']['byte_length'] and hashlib.sha256(name.encode()).hexdigest()==v['sha256']==decl['declared_name']['value_sha256'] and decl['module_context'][0]['name']==v['module'] and name in text[v['line']-1] and e['extraction_status']=='UNKNOWN' and leaf in sids),sourceLine=text[v['line']-1]))
check('closed event witnesses',all(e['ok'] for e in wresults),wresults)
out={'checks':checks,'allPass':all(e['ok'] for e in checks),'procedureBindings':dict(collections.Counter(e['primaryProcedure'] for e in sem)),'scope':read('scope.json'),'rawCatalogOriginal427':raw,'limit':'Static data equality and documentary reference integrity only. No semantic/runtime acceptance. Original rows only; no semantic inspection of other catalog/matrix entries.'}
(D/'static-identity-partition.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n')
